def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    vals = sorted(set(a))
    rank = {v: i + 1 for i, v in enumerate(vals)}
    m = len(vals)
    tree = [0] * (m + 1)
    res = [0] * n
    size = 0

    def update(x: int, d: int) -> None:
        while x <= m:
            tree[x] += d
            x += x & -x

    for i in range(n):
        # Window for position i is [i - k, i - 1]. Add i - 1 first so k = 0 also works.
        if i >= 1:
            update(rank[a[i - 1]], 1)
            size += 1
        # Drop index i - k - 1, which has just left the window.
        j = i - k - 1
        if j >= 0:
            update(rank[a[j]], -1)
            size -= 1
        # Count window elements strictly greater than a[i].
        q = 0
        x = rank[a[i]]
        while x > 0:
            q += tree[x]
            x -= x & -x
        res[i] = size - q

    return res
